summary: Frontend E2E validation of Kairos honest-cockpit + theme + settings modal work as designed. Login via POST /api/auth/login with sara@zayado.fr / SaraTest2026! (JWT stored under localStorage 'kairos_access_token') — /api/auth/me returns email=sara@zayado.fr (prenom=None as expected for a client with blank profile). All 8 requested flows verified against real Sara account (not demo fallback).

ui_bugs.issue: Empty-state exists visually ('Set my goal' button) but the data-testid="goal-empty" is missing on the card (count=0 for Sara who has no goal). All other empty-state testids present: energy-first-checkin=1, victory-empty=1, priorities-empty=1, trend-empty=1.

issues: Language defaults to English on first load (UI shows 'Hello, Sara' / 'Set my goal' / 'Weekly review' / 'TODAY' instead of French). Not a bug per se — Général > Langue selector defaults to 'English'. Recommend defaulting to French for the FR product.

action_items: (LOW) Add data-testid="goal-empty" attribute to the empty state of the 3-year goal card in Cockpit.jsx so the spec matches implementation.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend login form (/login) is passwordless (magic link + SSO only) but backend still exposes POST /api/auth/login with password. Tests must login via API — document this in QA guide.
Parametres.jsx section-search behavior is elegant: filtering the nav auto-switches to the first visible section (validated with 'promo' → jumps to Forfait & promo). Nice UX.
server.py is 3269 lines — still needs splitting (repeated feedback from iteration_1).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 requested flows pass; 1 missing testid is a minor spec gap, not a functional bug)

test_credentials: sara@zayado.fr / SaraTest2026! (validated) — login via POST /api/auth/login, store JWT in localStorage['kairos_access_token'].
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded Sara account. One check-in energy=4 was saved during the Bien-être flow; subsequent runs will see the '7 derniers jours' chart instead of the empty state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Login.jsx uses passwordless magic link — you cannot log in Sara through the UI form. Use POST /api/auth/login and inject token: localStorage.setItem('kairos_access_token', token). Sara has NO 'Set goal' data-testid on Cockpit (only 'goal-empty' is missing there). Bien-être check-in was performed during this iteration, so the history-empty state may not repeat.
